description: There are distinct ultrafilters on the naturals extending the cofinite filter, one containing the evens and the other containing the odds.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FiltersAndUltrafilters.parity_extensions :
  ∃ U V, ↑U ≤ Filter.cofinite ∧ ↑V ≤ Filter.cofinite ∧ {n | n % 2 = 0} ∈ U ∧ {n | n % 2 = 1} ∈ V ∧ U ≠ V
